text:
Zoe: Quick design huddle: finalizing form validation patterns for Console. 3 items: inline vs top-summary for long forms, required markers (asterisk vs visible label), and destructive confirmations (undo snackbar vs typed confirm). Short takes?

Kai: Inline errors for field-level issues. Top summary only for large multi-field submissions or server-side failures that affect multiple fields.

Maya: Agree. Suggest rule: if form > 7 fields or multi-step -> top summary on submit + anchor links to fields. Otherwise inline on blur/submit.

Sam: Accessibility: asterisk alone is ambiguous. If we use '*' visually, add an offscreen "Required" span and set aria-required on the input. Don't rely on color alone.

Olivia: UX compromise: show visible "Required" helper only in low-density views or where users scan many optional fields. Otherwise sr-only label keeps UI tidy.

Zoe: Proposal to standardize: visual '*' + sr-only "Required" for most; visible "Required" helper for bulk/long forms. Also `aria-required=\"true\"` on the input.

Kai: Deletion patterns: soft delete + undo snackbar for single item. For bulk delete show count and scope, allow undo, but for permanent/irreversible actions use typed confirm.

Maya: Edge-case: slow networks -> snackbar may vanish before user sees it. Ensure Trash + activity log can recover for at least 30 days. Don't make undo the only recovery mechanism.

Sam: Accessibility checklist to include in the doc:
- Inline errors: set role="alert" and focus the first error on submit. Use aria-invalid on invalid fields.
- Top summary: role="alert" list with anchor links that focus the field when activated.
- Required: aria-required and sr-only hint.
- Typed confirm: ensure the input is labelled, and describe permanence clearly.

Olivia: Copy examples:
- Undo snackbar: "Moved to Trash — Undo"
- Bulk delete toast: "Deleted 12 items. Restore from Trash within 30 days."
- Typed confirm prompt: "Type the resource name to permanently delete: \"Project Apollo\""

Zoe: OK action items: Kai to draft the pattern doc with code snippets, Olivia to add a11y examples, Sam to propose microcopy variants, Maya to define thresholds for when to show top summary. I'll sync with Eng on server error payload shape so we can wire anchor links.
